conditions.note: no build or other heavy job may run during a timed run (232g pinned conditions)

protocol.F: 5 warm-up + 20 timed steps, one mpm analyze, one profiler run
protocol.A: 2 warm-up + 6 timed steps, one profiler run per step
protocol.T: N * n_timed / sum of the profiler's step wall (mpm.a.step in mode A)
